picks.why: Arista has a 45% operating margin, 38% revenue growth and a 31.5 forward P/E, and sits only 22% off its high, so it is the quality name in a segment down 31% on the month. It rallied after the Democratic sweep, which fits the thesis that AI demand outruns supply (ai-demand-exceeds-supply).
picks.risk: Hyperscaler or neocloud capex cuts after a funding squeeze would hit its orders.

picks.why: Primoris is a 15.3 forward P/E grid contractor 61% off its high that beat earnings and gave strong guidance, in the only segment rising on five days. It is a cheap way to own the power-constraint thesis (power-is-the-binding-constraint).
picks.risk: Revenue is down 11% with a negative operating margin, so the beat may be a one-off.
